Our Story

Made for the water, designed in Western Australia

Truly Blu is a small swimwear label from Western Australia. Every bikini, tee and pair of board shorts starts on the WA coast — and is made with the ocean in mind.

Swimwear with a conscience

Truly Blu bikinis are made from recycled ocean plastics and organic, responsibly sourced fabrics. Choosing Truly Blu is a conscious choice for the planet: ethical manufacturing, fair labour, low-impact dyes and minimal packaging are built into every piece.

Fabric that gives back

Many pieces use ECONYL® regenerated nylon — made from regenerated fishing nets and other nylon waste — in Carvico Vita fabric from Italy, certified to the Global Recycled Standard and OEKO-TEX®.

This page brings together what Truly Blu shares on its Sustainability page and product pages. The brand's fuller story is to be confirmed by Truly Blu.

Shop the collection

Sustainability

A conscious choice for the planet

Truly Blu bikinis are made from recycled ocean plastics and organic, responsibly sourced fabrics.

How Truly Blu works

  • Recycled ocean plastics and organic, responsibly sourced fabrics across the bikini range.
  • Ethical manufacturing and fair labour.
  • Low-impact dyes that are kinder to waterways.
  • Minimal packaging on every order.

In the fabrics

From the product pages: pieces in ECONYL® regenerated nylon (78% ECONYL® regenerated nylon, 22% elastane) use Carvico Vita fabric — made from regenerated fishing nets and other nylon waste, Italian fabric, Global Recycled Standard, OEKO-TEX® certified. Other pieces use recycled polyamide and recycled polyester blends, detailed on each product page.

Carvico fabrics are ultra-chlorine resistant, sun cream and oil resistant, pilling resistant, and give excellent coverage — made to last season after season, not landfill after one summer.
